_doc: Paths that must not reach main on an agent's own authority (modeled on universal-auth scripts/risky-paths.json). A PR touching any of them needs the label below, added by a human. Created 2026-11-04 because BB_maps had none and the pre-push case-gate fails closed without it.
label: human-reviewed
_tuning: Patterns are case-sensitive JavaScript regexes on repo-relative POSIX paths. ci-and-protection and deploy match real files; the others are guards for the first such file.
